verdict.rationale: Jina's search endpoint explicitly searches the web, fetches top 5 results, and returns full LLM-ready page content in one call (gh-2), directly matching the story. However, community reports show real-world failures (401 auth errors, 404s) when invoking the API, and details like JS-rendering support or rate limits are unclear from docs, so delivery is credible but not unambiguously reliable.
